title: Cognition Releases SWE-2: A Kimi K3 Post-Trained Coding Model That Matches Fable 5.1 on FrontierCode at 64% Lower Cost
summary: Cognition, the company behind the Devin coding agent, has released SWE-2, its most capable coding model to date. SWE-2 is post-trained with reinforcement learning from Kimi K3, Moonshot AI’s 2.8T-parameter open model. Cognition reports a score of 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within 1 point of Fable 5.1 at 64% lower cost.
